name: image-log
description: A gallery beside Claude of every image it makes, reads or receives, and the ones you send it. Logs paths only, never copies your files.

openOn.title: Open the gallery automatically
openOn.description: claude: when Claude makes or receives an image (not when you send one). any: on any new image. never: only with /image-log. An open gallery shows every new image either way.

includeReads.title: Log images Claude reads
includeReads.description: Also log image files Claude opens with the Read tool (e.g. your screenshots)

includeSent.title: Log images you send
includeSent.description: Also log images you paste or drop into the prompt

galleryPane.title: Gallery beside Claude
galleryPane.description: Open the image gallery in a herdr pane or kitty split next to Claude instead of Claude's own Images pane. Needs python3 with Pillow; in kitty also allow_remote_control and listen_on.
